channel.title: TuneCue
channel.description: Stage MIDI control for Auto-Tune in UAD Console

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
What changed

The iPad remote now notices when the Mac has gone and says so on one STATUS button, instead of staying green; it reconnects by itself once the Remote's address can be reached again. Switching setlist no longer restarts the engine. Stage shows when a change is pending, confirmed, or unsuccessful, and a tile lights when Console confirms the change. A new header puts the Setup's name and recent files in one place, with Settings behind the gear. On Mappings and Cues the ↻ turns on its own and the controls beside it stay put. Fixed an issue after MIDI Learn that left app/Remote and MIDI commands using separate engine queues. Save refuses a rig that would not open again. Backups get names of their own and are kept per kind and per Setup. New log entries carry the time and no longer include the Remote PIN; support packages redact sensitive information.
